n261f695d80.headline: Minister of Finance: We are keen on the gradual implementation of the electronic invoice project
n261f695d80.summary: Egypt's Finance Minister Mohamed Maait confirmed the electronic invoice system is part of a national project to modernize and automate tax administration, facilitating taxpayers and governance.
n261f695d80.why: Modernizing tax systems can improve compliance, government revenue, and business environment.
